sections.text:
[Effects]
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by XL - 5XL based on the time elemental attack value.
Ability Power scales with the number of Time elemental Axe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 5XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate against Star enemies increases to L+.
Activation rate scales with the number of Time elemental Axe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
